meaning: High temperature heater error: Samsung says the temperature inside the dishwasher is too hot.
causes: The temperature inside the dishwasher is too hot, the cause Samsung gives
diySteps: Switch the power to the dishwasher off for 30 seconds at the circuit breaker, then switch it back on
Fill the detergent drawer, then start a Normal cycle
If HC occurs again, request service through Samsung's Support Center
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Not the same as HE. Samsung's HE means the inside temperature is being detected incorrectly, and its steps do not start with the 30-second breaker reset that HC starts with. Not the same as 3E, which is a hot water supply above 176°F. Rotary 1E uses the same breaker, empty, detergent and Normal-cycle steps as HC, but 1E on a Waterwall model is a clogged filter instead. Read the characters on the display.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
